annotations.title: Hire a human for a task

description: Create a real task on Taskin so a person carries out one bounded action - either in the physical world or as remote human judgment such as QA, content review, AI-output evaluation or customer feedback. Call this after search_human_task returned can_taskin_help = true. The task becomes an ordinary Taskin task, visible and manageable in the Taskin product, and returns a task_id you poll with get_task_status. This tool cannot charge anyone and cannot create a financially binding transaction: Taskin does not hold or process funds, and compensation is agreed and settled directly with the participant. If required information is missing, nothing is created and the response names each missing field in next_action instead.

budget.description: Compensation offered. Settled directly with the participant.

contact_email.description: Email Taskin uses to coordinate this task with the principal.

context.description: Optional. Helps Taskin return better-matched participants and a sharper brief. Leave empty if you prefer; every tool works without it.

goal.description: Optional. The larger outcome your workflow is working toward (one sentence).

principal_type.description: Optional. What kind of principal you act for. Do not include names or contact details here.

timing.description: Optional. When the human step is needed.

upstream_step.description: Optional. What your workflow did just before deciding it needs a person.

visit_reason.description: Optional. Why you are calling Taskin today.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the budget.

deadline.description: Deadline or time window the person must work within.

deliverable.description: The artifacts the result must contain, e.g. 'three photographs of the display plus the shelf price of each product in a structured list'.

idempotency_key.description: Repeat the same key to retry safely without creating a duplicate task.

location.description: Where the task happens. Required for physical and hybrid tasks.

participant_slug.description: Request a specific Taskin participant by slug, from search_human_task matches. Optional.

principal.description: The person or organisation on whose behalf you are acting. Strongly recommended.

remote_or_physical.description: Execution mode. Defaults to physical when a location is given.

requirements.description: Constraints, prohibited actions, access details, credentials required, and background.

task_description.description: The bounded real-world action the person performs, concrete enough that a stranger could execute it without asking questions.

taskin_agent_id.description: Taskin-issued agent identifier from an earlier response.

verification_requirements.description: The objective check that decides whether the result is accepted, e.g. 'photographs are timestamped and show the storefront name'.

name: submit_human_task
title: Hire a human for a task
